entities.name: Arlinn Kord
entities.description: A planeswalker and werewolf who defeats Tovolar by a trick, then gives her blood for the Harvesttide ritual and throws the key to Olivia to save Katilda.

entities.name: Tovolar
entities.description: A huge werewolf and Arlinn's former mentor who leads the attack on Harvesttide and wants her to come home to the pack.

entities.name: Olivia Voldaren
entities.description: A vampire lady who swoops down during the ritual, takes Katilda hostage and gets the Moonsilver Key.

entities.name: Katilda
entities.description: The leader of the Dawnhart Coven, whose soul is drawn out of her during the ritual and whom Olivia seizes.

entities.name: Kaya
entities.description: A planeswalker who watches over the ritual and sees Katilda's soul leave her.

entities.name: Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: A pyromancer who helps carry the wounded Arlinn to the ritual.

entities.name: Adeline
entities.description: A cathar commander who rides with Chandra and Arlinn to the Celestus.

entities.name: Teferi
entities.description: A planeswalker who slowed the sun and has gone ahead to the ritual.

entities.name: Worrin Betzold
entities.description: A bishop of the Grand Cathedral of Thraben who once recommended Arlinn for the Archmagi.

entities.name: Arlinn's father
entities.description: A smith in Kessig who covered his workshop with holy symbols; his house burned down.

entities.name: Streak
entities.description: One of Arlinn's wolves, who bites her shoulder on Tovolar's side.

entities.name: Boulder
entities.description: One of Arlinn's wolves who pins her down with Tovolar.

entities.name: Redtooth
entities.description: A wolf in Tovolar's pack who threatens Arlinn.

entities.name: Patience
entities.description: Arlinn's wolf who stays apart from the pack and comes to her side.

entities.name: Dawnhart Coven
entities.description: The masked witches who perform the Harvesttide ritual on the central platform.

entities.name: Cathars
entities.description: The guards who fought the raid and survive bruised and battered.

entities.name: Candleguides
entities.description: Strange smiling spirits who point the way for the dead.

entities.name: Moonsilver Key
entities.description: The key for the ritual that Arlinn hurls to Olivia to save Katilda, and which Olivia takes away.

entities.name: Sungold Lock
entities.description: The lock that Arlinn anoints with blood and herb in the golden bowl.

entities.name: The Celestus
entities.description: The ancient machine whose arms glow and groan during the ritual and which falls silent when the key is taken.

entities.name: Harvesttide Massacre
entities.description: The name given by survivors to the wolves' attack on the festival.

entities.name: The Travails
entities.description: The earlier catastrophe that the aftermath of the massacre reminds Arlinn of.

entities.name: Innistrad
entities.description: The plane where night now falls forever.

entities.name: Thraben
entities.description: The city whose Grand Cathedral Arlinn remembers.

events.summary: Arlinn remembers returning home years ago to find her family's forge burned to a husk.
events.quote: A husk meets her: blackened foundations jutting from the earth.

events.summary: Arlinn, in wolf form, attacks Tovolar at the festival and he throws her to the ground.
events.quote: Forward. Powerful legs send her flying through the air

events.summary: Tovolar slams Arlinn into a split tree trunk, and she tears out a piece of wood and drives it through his leg.
events.quote: she has pierced him all the way through

events.summary: Streak, Redtooth and Boulder pin Arlinn down, and she is stunned by a blow to the head.
events.quote: there is Streak with his jaws firmly locked on her already wounded shoulder

events.summary: Tovolar urges Arlinn to join the hunt and says that the Church hates part of her but the pack does not.
Arlinn tells Tovolar she is home so he lets her up, then drives her claws into his sternum.
events.quote: She drives her claws deep into his sternum.

events.summary: Arlinn tells Tovolar Innistrad is home, and he calls her a liar.
Tovolar agrees to call off the attack, and the wolves howl a retreat.
events.quote: The howl goes up soon after that, a call for retreat only the wolves understand.

events.summary: Arlinn surveys the aftermath, which survivors call the Harvesttide Massacre, and resolves that the ritual must be completed.
events.quote: the word has already been formed: massacre .

events.summary: Chandra and Adeline pick up the wounded Arlinn and take her to the Celestus.
events.quote: Shifting to her human form, Arlinn takes Chandra's hand.

events.summary: The Dawnhart Coven, Katilda holding the key and Kaya waiting beside her, performs the chanting ritual at the central platform.
events.quote: Katilda, her mask shading much of her face, the Moonsilver Key held in her hands like something sacred and pure

events.summary: The witches call Arlinn as the Child of Blood and Fang and ask whether she will spill blood for the day; she agrees.
events.quote: "Child of Blood and Fang. You stand on the line of Dawn, where Night and Day meet."

events.summary: Arlinn anoints the bowl of the Sungold Lock with her blood and a bitter herb, and the Celestus stirs to life.
Katilda offers a root and her soul to the bowl; her soul streams out of her eyes and mouth and her body goes limp.
events.quote: a silver glow comes over them, then streams out

events.summary: Olivia Voldaren crashes down in a streak of red and gold, seizes Katilda and reaches for the key; Arlinn dives and secures it.
events.quote: Katilda swallowed up in its impossible color.

events.summary: Olivia offers to trade Katilda for the key and cuts her chest to force a decision.
events.quote: she rakes her claws across Katilda's chest.

events.summary: The witches say the ritual had to be done by Katilda, so Arlinn throws the key to Olivia.
events.quote: Arlinn hurls the key with her good arm.

events.summary: Olivia throws Katilda toward the altar, injuring them both, and flies away with the key.
events.quote: By the time the world stops spinning, the vampire is gone.

events.summary: With the key gone, the Celestus falls silent and night settles on Innistrad for eternity.

relations.note: He looked after her when she first changed.
relations.quote: The Tovolar who looked after her has grown into the Tovolar who attacks innocents

relations.note: She stops his attack by wounding him.
He sides with Tovolar against Arlinn.
relations.quote: there is Streak with his jaws firmly locked on her already wounded shoulder

relations.note: He recommended her for the Archmagi.
relations.quote: He was the one who recommended her for the Archmagi.
she can be sure it's Katilda pulling the strings.

relations.note: She takes the key and Katilda against Arlinn's side.
relations.quote: "I've got your witch; you've got my key."

relations.note: Chandra helps her to the ritual.
relations.quote: "You're in bad shape, come with us!"

relations.note: Kaya works with her at the ritual.
relations.quote: Kaya's at Arlinn's side in an instant.

relations.note: He warned her to mind herself in the woods.
relations.quote: "Mind yourself in the woods, Arlinn," he says.
